# @vllnt/convex-email

> TypeScript Convex component for outbound transactional email: durable send queue, retry budget, idempotent enqueue, delivery status, SMTP and JMAP senders.

Install `@vllnt/convex-email` (builds from `main` use the `canary` dist-tag).
Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0`; optional `nodemailer@^8.0.4 || ^9.0.0 ||
^10.0.0` only for `@vllnt/convex-email/smtp`. ES modules only. Mount it with
`app.use(email)` from `@vllnt/convex-email/convex.config` and call it through
`new Email<TPayload>(components.email, { payloadValidator?, maxAttempts? })`
from host functions. Methods: `enqueue(ctx, messageId, to, from, transport,
opts?)`, `markSending`, `markSent(ctx, id, { providerId? })`,
`markFailed(ctx, id, { error? })`, `get`, `listByStatus(ctx, status,
paginationOpts)`, `prune(ctx, { before?, batch? })`. Lifecycle: `queued` ->
`sending` (`markSending`, `attempts + 1`) -> `sent`, or back to `queued` via
`markFailed` while `attempts < maxAttempts` (default 5), else `failed`. `sent`
and `failed` are final. The component stores the message and its status; it
never sends email and never reads auth. Your action claims a message, sends it
with `createJmapSender` (`./jmap`, plain `fetch`, default runtime) or
`createSmtpSender` (`./smtp`, needs `nodemailer` and `"use node"`), then calls
`markSent` or `markFailed`, and schedules retries itself. An `idempotencyKey`
returns the existing message (`deduplicated: true`). Errors are `ConvexError`s
with `data.code` `INVALID_ARGUMENT`, `INVALID_MAX_ATTEMPTS`,
`DUPLICATE_MESSAGE`, `NOT_FOUND`, `TERMINAL_STATE`, `INVALID_TRANSITION`,
`INVALID_BATCH` or `INVALID_BEFORE`. A daily cron deletes `sent`/`failed`
messages 30 days after their last update (`prune` batch 200, range 1..500).
There is no lease for a message stuck in `sending`, no exactly-once delivery
and no React entry.

## When to use

- Use it when a mutation must record an outbound email and return before the
  email is sent.
- Use it when you send through your own SMTP or JMAP server, or another
  transport you call from a Convex action.
- Use it when you need a per-message status (`queued`, `sending`, `sent`,
  `failed`) and a cap on send attempts.
- Use it when a retried request must not queue the same email twice.
- Do not use it when the message is an in-app inbox item with read/unread
  state: use `@vllnt/convex-notifications`.
- Do not use it when you want a component that calls the Resend API itself and
  tracks delivery webhooks: use `@convex-dev/resend`.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-email/` and
match the installed version. Read them, and the shipped `src/`, before writing
code. The links below to `./` paths are files inside the installed package.

## Examples

Repository only, not in the npm package:

- [Example host functions](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-email/blob/main/example/convex/example.ts): Host wrappers, and SMTP, JMAP and routed send loops with fake transports
- [Example tests](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-email/blob/main/example/convex/example.test.ts): End-to-end usage with `convex-test`
